Dear Friend, Once again our old friend Franz Sigel has taken command in our corps.... we have not met for a long time and the first night we talked an drank beer together...it has really been a long journey from the battlefields at the Rhine river up to here into Shenandoah valley.... Our original orders were to defend our own railway connections and to destroy the enemy ones... The wider stakes are clear: THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES -----{end of secret telegraph depeche}----. Concentrate your best units, protect the flanks of the advance, and seize the decisive objectives before the enemy can rebuild a line.

The wider stakes are clear: THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES -----{end of secret telegraph depeche}----. Secure the approaches, protect your supply route, and reduce the enemy's positions one district at a time.

Stedman + Five Forks) places your command at ----{secret telegraph depeche to general}-----. Furthermore half of the liberated slaves from Fort Fisher wished to fight on with you: we have formed three regiments and have put them under your direct command.... If we close the siege and take Petersburg we have depraved General Lee from any action possibility. The wider stakes are clear: You and your corps get the honor to start our attack... Scout first, avoid prepared strongpoints, and use speed to seize crossings, junctions, and retreat routes.

intro: The railway is the front: whoever controls its stations controls movement, supply, and initiative. May, 9., 1865 The Key to Richmond places your command at Dear Friend,. Dear Friend, General Lee and President Davis flew to Richmond, capital of the CSA and their last stronghold. ORDERS: Sir, now that we took Petersburg, the confederates are retreating to Richmond, their last stronghold and capital of the Confederate States of America. The wider stakes are clear: THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES -----{end of secret telegraph depeche}----. Secure the junctions, protect the track, and use mobile firepower before the enemy can isolate your train or sever the line behind it.

intro: The campaign has reached a point where speed matters as much as firepower. June, 23., 1865 Final Assault at Richmond places your command at Dear Friend,. Dear Friend, it is now that we are in front of the lion's hole... the lion is hurted and has drawn back to the outmost corner of his cave... but he still is really dangerous..... may be even more dangerous then ever... before as he knows there is nothing to lose for him.... I do not know how this will end, but I feel this is the end of the war.. one way or the other..this is the final decision...

briliant.text:
Final Assault at Richmond * BV

----{secret telegraph depeche to general}-----
THE WHITE HOUSE; WASHINGTON,

Dear Sir,
Unbelievable, you made it !!!
You have taken Richmond and the enemy had to surrender !
The war is over ! We have won !
if you plan to run for presidency in the future, I could help you with advice...
God bless and long live liberty !

THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES
-----{end of secret telegraph depeche}----

dear friend,
we have won, I fullfilled my duty: I resign as general, return to my school and teach young people again.....
there is one thing that I will teach them for sure: Their are times where freedom must be defended....
and here my friend, here ends my long journey to freedom.
